examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The perks of an upgrade card: four included features, each behind a check mark, in one column.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureList from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-list'

  const features = [
    { label: 'Unlimited Applications' },
    { label: 'Unlimited Workloads' },
    { label: 'Custom Domains' },
    { label: 'Priority Support' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureList
    :items="features"
    aria-label="Pro plan features"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: Eight perks at `columns: 2`: two columns when the list's own box is at least the md container, one column below it.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureList from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-list'

  const features = [
    { label: 'Unlimited Applications' },
    { label: 'Unlimited Workloads' },
    { label: 'Custom Domains' },
    { label: 'Priority Support' },
    { label: 'Real-Time Metrics' },
    { label: 'Data Stream' },
    { label: 'Web Application Firewall' },
    { label: 'Team Permissions' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureList
    :items="features"
    :columns="2"
    aria-label="Pro plan features"
  />
</template>

examples.name: WithDescriptions
examples.summary: The features of a change-plan drawer, each with a one-line description under its label.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import FeatureList from '@aziontech/webkit/feature-list'

  const features = [
    {
      label: 'Unlimited Applications',
      description: 'Deploy as many applications as your projects need.'
    },
    {
      label: 'Custom Domains',
      description: 'Serve every application from your own domain, with managed certificates.'
    },
    {
      label: 'Priority Support',
      description: 'Reach the support team by chat and get an answer within one business day.'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <FeatureList
    :items="features"
    aria-label="Pro plan features"
  />
</template>
